message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable buffer before parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":777,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes become the exact parser span."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":792,"var":"lexer.end","code":".end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer end pointer is derived from the attacker-controlled length."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":460,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\"' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"\"\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"A triple-double-quote prefix routes parsing into the multiline-string scanner."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":340,"var":"end","code":"char *end = (peek(lexer) == '\"') ? \"\"\" : \"'''\";","note":"The scanner chooses the closing delimiter from the opening quote style."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":345,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) {","note":"The scanner compares three bytes at the current cursor against the delimiter; this is the suspected over-read site."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":347,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"lexer->pos += 3;","note":"On delimiter match the cursor advances three bytes, which can step beyond the buffer if the delimiter is at the tail."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print('trace updated')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
